# TASK T8.1 — Harden the DXF export for Jw_cad / AutoCAD LT compatibility (PKG lane). Own `packages/cad-export/**`, `docs/cad-compat.md`. Do not edit the planner/bdm or the app.

Findings from an independent audit (reviewer, python `ezdxf` 1.4.4, DXF of the default plan): version AC1015 (R2000), units mm, 0 structural errors in recover mode, 300 entities (LINE/LWPOLYLINE/ARC/TEXT), layers `F1-WALL-EXT, F1-WALL-INT, F1-DOOR, F1-WINDOW, F1-ROOM, F1-STAIR, F1-DIM, F1-TEXT, F2-*, SITE, TITLE`. One audit fix: "INVALID_OWNER_HANDLE (#202): Fixed invalid owner handle in root DICTIONARY". Extents 42.0 x 29.7 m (probably the A3 frame at 1:100, check it).
Tasks:
1. Reproduce: write `packages/cad-export/scripts/audit.py`-free check in TS (`scripts/audit.ts`, no new dependency): generate DXFs for the default plan + 1-storey + narrow-lot plan via `generatePlansSafe`, and check structural rules: unique handles, every `owner` handle exists, `$HANDSEED` > max handle, `$INSUNITS`=4, `$MEASUREMENT`=1, header/tables/blocks/entities/objects sections, BLOCK_RECORD tables for model/paper space, layer table entries for every used layer, every entity layer exists, no NaN/Infinity, coordinates in mm, ACI colours 1–255, `EOF`. Fix the owner-handle defect (root DICTIONARY and any other).
2. Compatibility knobs (default stays R2000): option `version: 'R12' | 'R2000'` — R12 (AC1009) = the safest for Jw_cad/old CAD (LINE/ARC/CIRCLE/TEXT/POLYLINE only, no LWPOLYLINE, no handles required); implement the R12 writer path by converting LWPOLYLINE to POLYLINE+VERTEX+SEQEND; text uses Shift_JIS-safe encoding rules: for R12 write `$DWGCODEPAGE` ANSI_932 and encode Japanese text as `\M+` / `\U+XXXX` escapes (check `encodeDxfText`); document the choice and give both file extensions in the app helper names (`dxfFileName(model, {version})` — keep the old signature working).
3. Drawing quality: layers with sensible ACI colours and lineweights (ext. wall 0.5 mm, int. wall 0.25, door/window 0.18, dim 0.13), wall thickness drawn as closed double-line polylines, door swing arcs, window symbol (3 lines), stairs with arrow and "UP" text, room names + areas as TEXT (height 150–250 mm at 1:100), dimension chains (as lines+text if DIMENSION entities are risky), north arrow, scale bar, simple title block (project name, scale 1:100, date placeholder, "AI HOME PLATFORM"), paper frame A3 (420 x 297 mm at 1:100 => 42,000 x 29,700 model units) on layer `TITLE`. Verify the A3 frame matches the extents.
4. Write `docs/cad-compat.md`: what was verified and how (the TS audit + ezdxf result), what is NOT verified (opening in Jw_cad / AutoCAD LT / DraftSight — nobody has done it), and a 10-line manual checklist for a human with Jw_cad: open file, check unit/scale (1/100), layers, text encoding, that a 3,640 mm wall measures 3640, print preview.
Shell allowed (only): `docker compose exec -T vite pnpm --filter @aihome/cad-export typecheck|lint|test|exec tsx scripts/audit.ts|exec prettier --write`, same for `@aihome/planner` typecheck only. Everything else with file tools (no cat/ls/grep/sleep/rm). Denied -> skip + report.
Existing tests must pass (update expectations only if the old output was wrong; say so). Files <= 150 lines, no any/as, no new unit tests (BRIEF 3-TEMP). Final report: audit table before/after, what is verified/not verified.
